items.a: App automation testing runs scripted tests against native and hybrid mobile apps on every build, without manual tapping.

items.q: Which mobile frameworks does TestMu AI support?
items.a: Appium, Espresso, XCUITest and Maestro, on real iOS and Android devices.

items.q: Do I need to change my Appium tests?
items.a: No. You change the remote URL and capabilities, then upload your app build.

items.q: Can I run mobile tests in parallel?
items.a: Yes. Suites run across many real devices at once, with video and logs per test.

items.q: How is this different from the Real Device Cloud?
items.a: The Real Device Cloud is the device fleet, used live or automated. App Automation is the automated-testing workflow that runs your framework suites on that fleet.
